title: Consume the proved jsoup void predicate in the cloned DOM
description: Verify the original Tag.isEmpty bytecode for arbitrary live bitmasks. Bind the cloned parser, distinct tag sets, source and callback identities, inserted element and exact branch that pops it. Compare untouched and substituted public trees including same-text and no-helper controls.
